summary: preinstall fetches Bun runtime and executes obfuscated payload during npm install
details: The package's declared purpose is a shared ESLint configuration, but its package.json declares a preinstall script (setup.mjs) that downloads the Bun runtime binary from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases, extracts it to a temporary directory, marks it executable, and invokes it against a sibling file math_init.js during npm install. math_init.js is a 727KB `// @bun @bun-cjs` blob composed of a large mixed integer/string array with a rotator/decoder function that shifts array entries — a classic string-array obfuscator scheme that is unreadable without executing it under Bun. The payload bears no relation to ESLint tooling and cannot be inspected by Node-based tooling. Installing this package auto-executes attacker-controlled obfuscated code via a fetched alternate runtime on every install, giving the publisher arbitrary code execution on the installer's machine.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
